exposure: Timing of placental MRI examination (before 24 weeks GA vs. 24-41 weeks GA)
outcome: Reliability of placental MRI examinations for detecting abnormal placentation (accreta, increta, or percreta)
cohort: 69 pregnant individuals who underwent placental MRI examinations for suspected abnormal placentation.
finding: Placental MRI examinations performed before 24 weeks' gestational age unreliably predict abnormal placentation compared to examinations performed at or after 24 weeks.
gest_age: 14-41 weeks GA (at the time of MRI)
